meta.subtitle: IR-first · execution-path variants · versioned profile overlays

dimensions.D: 128 KDA, NoPE query/key, and value head width
dimensions.Da: 64 auxiliary NoPE query/key width retained by the checkpoint
dimensions.A: at most 9 AttnRes sources (8 completed blocks plus the live partial block)

facts.vision_attention_contract: joint attention over each packed t-by-h-by-w media segment with repeated per-frame 2D RoPE; the pinned checkpoint code does not execute separate spatial and temporal attention passes
facts.checkpoint_quantization: MXFP4 packed group-size 32 routed-expert linear weights, with attention, dense MLP, shared experts, LM head, vision tower, and multimodal projector excluded
facts.model_weight_precision: mixed checkpoint-native MXFP4 and unquantized weights according to the checkpoint ignore ledger

model.input_ids.equation: token_ids := request token ids with shape [B,T]

model.optional_vision_inputs.equation: pixel_values, grid_thws := optional packed image patches and temporal-height-width grids

model.multimodal_injection.equation: X_0[image_placeholder_positions] = F_image; all other positions retain token embeddings

model.decoder_stack.equation: P_93, B_8 = DecoderStack_93(X_0; 69 KDA, 24 Gated MLA, AttnRes block size 12)

vision.input.equation: vision_input := packed image patches [P,3,14,14] and grid_thws

vision.position_encoding.equation: X_pos = X_patch + Interpolate2D(position_table, per-image height and width) + FixedTemporalEncoding(time_index)

vision.block_stack.equation: X_encoded = VisionBlock_27(X_pos; each media item is one packed t*h*w attention segment)

vision.temporal_pool.equation: X_tpool = Mean(X_encoded over temporal groups selected by grid_thws)

vision.spatial_group.equation: X_group[m] = Concat(X_tpool[p] for p in one 2x2 spatial neighborhood)

vision.projector_hidden_activation.equation: Z = GELU(X_group * W_1^T), where W_1 is one biasless linear map from 4Hv to 4Hv and is not a gated pair

vision.projector_down.equation: F_raw = Z * W_2^T with output width H

vision_block.qkv_projection.equation: [Q,K,V] = Reshape(Xn * W_qkv^T,[P,3,Nv,Dv]), with Dv=1536/12=128; apply repeated per-frame 2D complex RoPE to Q and K

vision_block.joint_spatiotemporal_attent.equation: C = Softmax(QK^T/sqrt(Dv))V independently inside each packed media segment of length t*h*w

decoder_stack.input.equation: P_0 := text or multimodal embeddings [B,T,H]; completed-block bank B := empty

decoder_stack.layer_schedule.equation: for zero-based l in 0..92: KDA iff (l+1) belongs to the 69-entry KDA schedule, otherwise Gated MLA; dense MLP iff l=0, otherwise Stable LatentMoE

decoder.attn_res_read.equation: X_attn,l = AttnRes(B_<ceil(l/12), P_l) when at least one completed source exists; otherwise X_attn,l = P_l

decoder.attn_res_block_write.equation: if l mod 12 = 0: append P_l to completed-block bank B and reset live prefix before adding the layer deltas

decoder.attention_schedule.equation: Delta_attn,l = KDA_l(Xn_attn,l) or GatedMLA_l(Xn_attn,l) according to the immutable 1-based schedule

decoder.kda.equation: Delta_attn,l, C_l_next, S_l_next = KDA_l(Xn_attn,l, C_l_prev, S_l_prev)

decoder.prefix_after_attention.equation: P_attn,l = Base_l + Delta_attn,l, where Base_l is P_l unless a boundary reset occurred, then zero

decoder.feed_forward_schedule.equation: Delta_ffn,l = DenseSiTU(Xn_ffn,l) for l=0; otherwise StableLatentMoE_l(Xn_ffn,l)

decoder_stack.output.equation: P_93 and completed-block bank B_0..B_7 := decoder stack output

attn_res.bank_input.equation: B = [B_0,...,B_(a-2)] := immutable completed 12-layer block sources for this layer

attn_res.prefix_input.equation: P := current live partial-block prefix sum

kda.lower_bounded_decay.equation: g = g_min * sigmoid(exp(A_log) elementwise_mul z); alpha = exp(g), with g_min=-5

kda.recurrent_update.equation: S_t = (I - beta_t k_t k_t^T) Diag(alpha_t) S_(t-1) + beta_t k_t v_t^T

kda.gated_rmsnorm.equation: Y = G elementwise_mul RMSNorm(O; gamma_o, epsilon)

kda.output.equation: Delta_attn and updated conv/recurrent states := KDA output

mla.q_up.equation: Q = Reshape(Q_latent W_q_up^T,[B,T,N,D+Da]); no positional rotation is applied

mla.kv_down.equation: [C_raw,K_aux] = XW_kv_down^T with widths Ckv and Da

mla.key_compose.equation: K = Concat(K_nope, BroadcastHeads(K_aux)); Q and K both use D+Da NoPE channels

mla.cache_update.equation: KV_cache_next = Append(KV_cache_prev, [C,K_aux]); decode may algebraically absorb W_kv_up without changing this compressed-cache meaning

mla.attention.equation: O = Softmax(QK_cache^T/sqrt(D+Da)) V_cache under the causal mask

mla.output.equation: Delta_attn and updated compressed KV cache := Gated MLA output

moe.router_logits.equation: r = XW_router^T computed in fp32 with shape [B*T,E]

moe.corrected_selection.equation: expert_ids = TopK(s + correction_bias,K); correction bias affects selection only

moe.expert_down.equation: Y_e = A_eW_down,e^T in routed latent width Hr

moe.routed_up.equation: R = Yn_routed W_routed_up^T with width H

assumptions.semantic_math: The complete text-only pure-TP8 decode contract is represented at the exact BS1 baseline-relative step 513 coordinate. Every executed compute, state, and collective boundary has either an ideal lower-bound owner or an explicit structural inclusion in that owner.
assumptions.fusion_policy: Costs follow the SGLang graph-off reconciliation and graph-on ownership contract. A fused semantic child is structural and contributes only through its single measured owner; no measured interval or ideal cost is copied across children.
assumptions.overlap_policy: The top-level decoder, final AttnRes, and logits path is a serial semantic lower bound. No speculative cross-layer or cross-stream overlap is credited.
assumptions.cache_policy: MLA cache traffic uses the portable compressed Ckv+Da state. KDA state traffic uses the local 12-head matrix state. The selected decode coordinate has S=8192+513 cached positions.
assumptions.quantization_policy: Attention, dense MLP, shared experts, and LM head use the checkpoint BF16 exclusion ledger. Routed-MoE MXFP4 nodes use only their compulsory packed-weight and scale traffic as a safe physical lower bound because the shared hardware catalog has no FP4 compute peak.
assumptions.calibration_policy: The shared GB300 catalog contains theoretical ceilings only. This report separates physical ideal coverage from unavailable attainable projections and does not attribute the uncalibrated remainder to a framework.
